# apple_promote_app_store_version_experiment_treatment (Action)

Applies a product page optimization treatment to an App Store version, so that everyone sees it on the product page. Applying a treatment while its experiment is running ends the experiment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_promote_app_store_version_experiment_treatment" "orange" {
  config {
    version_id   = apple_app_store_version.example.id
    treatment_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment.orange.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `treatment_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the treatment, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment.example.id`.
- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.
